body:
Closes #330.

## What was wrong

The issue lists the runs on `main` for `b5af650` (merge of #326) and `0585fcf` (merge of #329). Three runs failed outright. Before that push, the scheduled runs had already failed on two more problems. Behind both sat a set of green runs that were hiding problems or printing errors nobody needed to act on.

| # | Class | Finding | Root cause |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| E1 | error | scheduled `security`: `npm audit` failed in `js` and `docs/website` | three new `brace-expansion` advisories (2026-09-29); fixed on `main` by Dependabot #328 and #329 before this PR |
| E2 | false positive | scheduled `links`: 7 "broken" links | github.com rate-limited lychee's default burst of 10 parallel requests (one 429, two 502). codefactor.io had a short outage (four 503s), and lychee never retries a 5xx, whatever `--max-retries` says |
| E3 | error + false negative | `dependency freshness`: trufflehog v3.98.0 → v3.98.1 → v3.99.0 | the policy works as designed; but the checker never read the action's separate `version:` input, so the scanner image had been unpinned all along |
| E4 | error + false negative | `csharp` → `generatePdfWithCode`: `LaTeX Error: Unicode character 😀 (U+1F600)` | #326 added emoji and CJK test strings; pdfLaTeX cannot typeset them, and the PDF job only ran on `main`, so #326 was green |
| E5 | false positive | `js` → `publishToNpm`: `0.23.0 ... not visible after 10 attempts` | npm now malware-scans new versions before serving them ("typically around five minutes", [changelog](https://github.blog/changelog/2026-07-28-npm-publish-time-malware-scanning-and-dual-use-metadata/)); 0.23.0 took 4 min 9 s, but the window was 150 s |
| N1 | false negative | `js_0.23.0` was never released, and `release-audit` said "in sync" | the release job ran only on `published == 'true'`; every re-run saw the version on npm, reported `skipped`, and never backfilled. The audit didn't look for GitHub releases |
| P1 | false positive | green `rust` publish job with four `##[error]ENOENT ... tests/trybuild` lines | `cargo publish` unpacks the crate under `target/package`, and `Swatinem/rust-cache` probes `tests/target` without `await`ing ([Swatinem/rust-cache#193](https://github.com/Swatinem/rust-cache/issues/193)) |
| W1–W10 | warnings | PEG0021/PEG0022, setup-java deprecated inputs, setup-go cache miss, CodeQL scanning `experiments/`, `dev/log/` and `benchmarks/java`, `ubuntu-latest` aliases, plus upstream-only deprecations. W10 (CodeQL: "too many (300) changed files") appears only on this PR, because of its 340 evidence files; CodeQL falls back to a full analysis. W11: a slow apt mirror nearly timed out the C# PDF job | see [`ROOT-CAUSES.md`](https://github.com/link-foundation/links-notation/blob/issue-330-9a9f62f53865/dev/log/issues/330/pulls/331/analysis/ROOT-CAUSES.md) |

The investigation is committed under [`dev/log/issues/330/pulls/331/`](https://github.com/link-foundation/links-notation/tree/issue-330-9a9f62f53865/dev/log/issues/330/pulls/331): 30 run logs, the timeline, the root causes, every requirement mapped to what was done, and a comparison of the seven templates. Start with its [`README.md`](https://github.com/link-foundation/links-notation/blob/issue-330-9a9f62f53865/dev/log/issues/330/pulls/331/README.md).

## What changed

| Commit | Fix |
| --- | --- |
| `ed6272d` | trufflehog action **and** scanner `version:` pinned to 3.99.0. `check-dependencies.py` now compares `version:` inputs of actions that wrap a separately released tool. |
| `8790d23` | The C# code PDF escapes characters pdfLaTeX cannot typeset as C# `\uXXXX`/`\UXXXXXXXX`, so the listing stays valid C#. The PDF job now runs on pull requests, and LaTeX errors become annotations. |
| `9a02947` | `lychee.toml`: `[hosts."github.com"]` with `concurrency = 2` and `request_interval = "1s"`, `429` accepted after retries. Drops a stale `.lycheeignore` entry and two redirecting URLs. |
| `5187c7e` | Registry verify windows sized from measured delays: npm 20 min, PyPI 10 min, NuGet 20 min. `publishRelease` in js, python, rust, java, php and csharp also runs on `published=skipped`, idempotently, so a missing GitHub release is backfilled. |
| `f2165be` | `release-audit` warns, with the `gh release create` command, when a published version has no GitHub release. |
| `a3a3a58` | setup-java `*-env-var` inputs; setup-go `cache: false` in `binary-interop`, which has no `go.mod` at the root. |
| `c3504d8` | The C# grammar's never-matching fallback ends with `.`, so Pegasus can prove it consumes input. No more PEG0021/PEG0022; parse results unchanged. |
| `bf9ccdc` | 67 runner labels pinned to `ubuntu-24.04`. `workflows.yml` fails if a `-latest` alias comes back. |
| `bb1b7fe` | `.github/codeql/codeql-config.yml` ignores `experiments/`, `dev/log/` and `benchmarks/java`. |
| `1ebcb5c` | The rust publish job deletes `target/package` before rust-cache saves, removing the ENOENT error annotations. |
| `91fb37c`, `051fb58` | Case study under `dev/log/issues/330/pulls/331/`. |
| `e803efd` | The C# PDF job keeps its 293 MB of TeX Live packages in the Actions cache. On this PR a slow apt mirror (223 kB/s) made the download take 22 of the job's 30 minutes, and the job now runs on every C# PR. |
| `c04967e` | `links.yml`: if lychee fails, wait 120 s and run it again. lychee never caches errors, so the second pass re-requests only the failed links, and a dead link still fails. |

No library behaviour changed, so there is no version bump. Merging re-runs all seven language workflows, because their workflow files changed. 0.23.0 is already on every registry it was published to, so nothing is republished. Thanks to the backfill, js creates the missing `js_0.23.0` release.

## How to reproduce, and the tests

| Finding | Reproduction or test |
| --- | --- |
| E3 | `python3 experiments/issue-325/test_dependency_check.py`: offline tests, including the `version:` input of a wrapped tool |
| E4 | `python3 experiments/issue-330/test_pdf_unicode.py`: emoji, CJK and BMP escapes. The `generatePdfWithCode` job also runs on this PR now. |
| P1 | `bash experiments/issue-330/rust-cache-enoent.sh`: runs `cargo package` into a temporary target dir and replays rust-cache's un-awaited probe. It prints the same two ENOENT paths as CI. |
| E2 | `bash experiments/issue-330/lychee-5xx-retry.sh`: a local server answers 503 once and then 200. With `--max-retries 3`, lychee 0.24.2 requests it only once and fails. The second `--cache` run re-requests only the 503 and 404 links; the recovered link passes and the 404 still fails. |
| E5, N1 | configuration only. N1 was verified on `bb1b7fe`: `release-audit` prints `js: 0.23.0 is on npm, but the GitHub release js_0.23.0 is missing`. |
| W4 | verified on `bb1b7fe` (security run 37534592831): the Rust "no manifest" and Java "POM ... missing" warnings are gone, and C# restores 7 projects instead of 18 |

These also passed locally: `bash scripts/ci/registry-probe.test.sh` (21/21), `python3 scripts/ci/check-dependencies.py` (152 declarations, all current), actionlint 1.7.12, and lychee (online and offline) over the new Markdown.

## Templates

All seven `*-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template` repositories were snapshotted and compared on ten questions ([`COMPARISON.md`](https://github.com/link-foundation/links-notation/blob/issue-330-9a9f62f53865/dev/log/issues/330/pulls/331/templates/COMPARISON.md)). Each has at least one of the defects fixed here, so each got a report with a reproduction, a workaround and a suggested fix:

| Report | Defect |
| --- | --- |
| [js#211](https://github.com/link-foundation/js-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/issues/211) | release gate only checks npm, so a missing GitHub release is never repaired; CodeQL scans `experiments/` |
| [python#96](https://github.com/link-foundation/python-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/issues/96) | a PyPI lag over ~100 s leaves the release permanently red (no wait, gate on the tag, no `skip-existing`) |
| [rust#187](https://github.com/link-foundation/rust-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/issues/187) | lychee 429s and unretried 5xx ([correction](https://github.com/link-foundation/rust-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/issues/187#issuecomment-6026216947)); CodeQL scans `experiments/`; ~60 s margin on the crates.io wait |
| [csharp#68](https://github.com/link-foundation/csharp-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/issues/68) | lychee 429s and unretried 5xx treated as broken links ([correction](https://github.com/link-foundation/csharp-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/issues/68#issuecomment-6026217327)) |
| [php#18](https://github.com/link-foundation/php-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/issues/18) | lychee 429s and unretried 5xx ([correction](https://github.com/link-foundation/php-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/issues/18#issuecomment-6026217636)); 21 jobs on `ubuntu-latest`; outdated pins |
| [java#12](https://github.com/link-foundation/java-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/issues/12) | the tag is pushed before the release, and a failed release never self-heals; `ubuntu-latest` |
| [go#11](https://github.com/link-foundation/go-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/issues/11) | same as java |

The third-party problems were already reported upstream, so they are linked rather than filed again: [Swatinem/rust-cache#193](https://github.com/Swatinem/rust-cache/issues/193) (fix in #387), [github/codeql#22766](https://github.com/github/codeql/issues/22766), lychee not retrying 5xx ([lycheeverse/lychee#2193, comment](https://github.com/lycheeverse/lychee/issues/2193#issuecomment-4939349025)), and the `DEP0005`/`DEP0040` deprecations in `download-artifact` and `deploy-pages` ([UPSTREAM.md](https://github.com/link-foundation/links-notation/blob/issue-330-9a9f62f53865/dev/log/issues/330/pulls/331/analysis/UPSTREAM.md)).

## Best practices

I checked this repository against all sixteen principles of [hive-mind's CI-CD-BEST-PRACTICES.md](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/blob/main/docs/CI-CD-BEST-PRACTICES.md) and its runner-pinning note ([`BEST-PRACTICES-COMPLIANCE.md`](https://github.com/link-foundation/links-notation/blob/issue-330-9a9f62f53865/dev/log/issues/330/pulls/331/analysis/BEST-PRACTICES-COMPLIANCE.md)). Runner pinning, release automation, secrets detection and docs validation were fixed here. Four gaps remain, each with a reason:

- **File-size limit:** `lib.rs` is 2053 lines and needs a split first.
- **Changesets:** the seven packages are versioned independently.
- **Fresh-merge validation:** it would touch every checkout and is unrelated to these failures.
- **Credential preflight:** none of these failures would have been prevented by it.

## Needs a maintainer

These can't be done from a PR. The workflows report each one as a notice or warning.

- `gh release create js_0.21.0 --target 4922c48 --title "[JS] 0.21.0" --generate-notes`
- `gh release create rust_0.16.0 --target 6f18805 --title "[Rust] 0.16.0" --generate-notes`

  Both versions are on their registries but have no GitHub release. They predate the backfill, and the audit checks only the declared version.
- **Java:** add `CENTRAL_USERNAME`, `CENTRAL_TOKEN`, `GPG_PRIVATE_KEY` and `GPG_PASSPHRASE`, or decide not to publish.
- **PHP:** submit the repository on packagist.org once.
- **PyPI:** register a trusted publisher for `python.yml`.
- **Go:** add `CODECOV_TOKEN`, or drop the Codecov upload.

Not changed on purpose: the dependency-freshness policy ("always latest"). It will go red again on the next trufflehog release until Dependabot opens the bump. That is the trade-off the policy chose.

commits.messageBody:
Adding .gitkeep for PR creation (default mode).
This file will be removed when the task is complete.

Issue: https://github.com/link-foundation/links-notation/issues/330

The dependency freshness run on main failed because trufflehog v3.99.0
was released. The scanner itself is pinned through the action's
`version:` input, which the checker never compared, so it was already
stale at 3.97.1 without anyone noticing. Track action inputs that pin a
separately released tool and bump both pins.
commits.messageHeadline: ci: track trufflehog scanner pin and bump it to 3.99.0

commits.messageBody:
PR #326 added test strings such as "😀 привет 世界" to
BinaryLinoCodecTests.cs. pdfLaTeX cannot typeset U+1F600 or CJK with the
T1/T2A encodings, so generatePdfWithCode failed on main (and with it the
gh-pages documentation). It only ran on main, so the PR stayed green.

format-files.py now spells characters outside the typesettable set as C#
\\u/\\U escapes, the PDF job also runs on pull requests, and LaTeX
errors are repeated as annotations instead of being buried in the log.
commits.messageHeadline: fix(csharp): keep the code PDF buildable with emoji and CJK sources

commits.messageBody:
The scheduled links run failed on 429/502 from github.com and 503 from
codefactor.io, not on dead links. lychee.toml now accepts 429 (lychee
retries it with backoff first) and checks github.com with 2 concurrent
requests 1s apart, as lychee's own hint suggests.

Also drop the stale .lycheeignore entry for /csharp/ on GitHub Pages
(it serves 200 now, so the exclusion only hid regressions) and replace
the redirecting flake8 and habr URLs with their targets.
commits.messageHeadline: ci(links): rate-limit github.com in lychee instead of failing on 429

commits.messageBody:
npm now scans each new version for malware before serving it (typically
about five minutes, sometimes 15+). js 0.23.0 became visible after 4m09s,
so the 150 second verify window failed a publish that had succeeded,
publishRelease was skipped, and because later runs report
published=skipped the js_0.23.0 GitHub release was never created.

- npm verify: 10x15s -> 80x15s, job timeout 15 -> 35 minutes
- PyPI verify: 10x15s -> 40x15s (0.23.0 used half the window), timeout 25
- NuGet verify: 20x30s -> 40x30s (0.23.0 used 7 of 10 minutes), timeout 35
- publishRelease in js/python/rust/java/php/csharp also runs when the
  version is already on the registry; the release step is idempotent, so
  this backfills a release an earlier run failed to create. Missing
  credentials still report published=failed and withhold the release.

Refs #330
commits.messageHeadline: ci(release): wait out registry scan delays and backfill missing releases

commits.messageBody:
…missing

The audit only compared the declared version with the registry, so js
0.23.0 read "in sync with npm" while its GitHub release had never been
created (the npm verify step timed out on a publish that had succeeded).
Each version that is on its registry is now also looked up as a GitHub
release (<lang>_<version>, go/v<version>), and a missing one is warned
about with the backfill command.

Refs #330
commits.messageHeadline: ci(release-audit): report published versions whose GitHub release is …

commits.messageBody:
- java publish: server-username/server-password/gpg-passphrase are
  deprecated aliases in setup-java v6 and logged three warnings per
  publish run; use the *-env-var inputs with the same values.
- binary-interop: setup-go cached by default and, with no go.sum, logged
  "Restore cache failed: Dependencies file is not found" on every run.
  The module has no dependencies, so the cache is off, as in go.yml.

Refs #330
commits.messageHeadline: ci: silence setup-java deprecation and setup-go cache warnings

commits.messageBody:
The fallback alternative of `element` is an always-failing predicate kept
for its side effect. Pegasus could not see that it never matches, treated
`element` as possibly zero-width and warned on every build:
PEG0021 at Parser.peg(288,59) (`line*`) and PEG0022 at (295,125)
(`indentedLinks?`). A trailing `.` that is never reached tells Pegasus the
alternative consumes input; parsing is unchanged and all tests pass.

Refs #330
commits.messageHeadline: fix(csharp): make the unreadable-line fallback visibly non-zero-width

commits.messageBody:
ubuntu-latest moves to a new Ubuntu release without any change in this
repository, which turns a toolchain break into what looks like flaky CI.
All 67 jobs already resolve to ubuntu-24.04 (see the 'Image:' line in
every log), so pinning changes nothing today; upgrading becomes an
explicit commit. workflows.yml now fails if a -latest alias returns.

Follows the hive-mind CI/CD best practices (Pin hosted runner operating
systems). Refs #330
commits.messageHeadline: ci: pin hosted runners to ubuntu-24.04 and guard against -latest aliases

commits.messageBody:
…chmark

CodeQL extracted every file in the checkout. The C# extractor restored
throwaway projects under experiments/, the Rust extractor warned about
evidence copies under dev/log/, and the Java buildless extractor reported
a missing links-notation jar on every run because benchmarks/java only
builds after a local mvn install. A config with paths-ignore limits the
analysis to code this repository ships and runs.

Refs #330
commits.messageHeadline: ci(codeql): stop scanning experiments, archived logs and the Java ben…

commits.messageBody:
…rrors

cargo publish unpacks each crate, tests/ included, under target/package.
Swatinem/rust-cache's post step treats any directory named tests as a
profile and probes tests/target and tests/trybuild without awaiting the
call, so the missing folders turned into four ##[error] annotations on the
green publishToCratesIO job of run 37486124161.

Upstream: Swatinem/rust-cache#193 (fix proposed in #387).
Reproduction: experiments/issue-330/rust-cache-enoent.sh
commits.messageHeadline: ci(rust): drop unpacked crates so rust-cache stops reporting ENOENT e…

commits.messageBody:
Logs of every examined run, the seven template snapshots and their
comparison, the bodies of the issues filed against the templates, and
the analysis: timeline, root causes, requirements, best-practice
compliance, upstream and maintainer actions, and prior art.

… 5xx

The scheduled run of 2026-10-05 also failed on four codefactor.io 503s and
two github.com 502s, which were up again minutes later. lychee only treats
a rejected 429 as retryable, so --max-retries never applied to them. A
second pass after two minutes re-requests just the failures, since lychee
never caches an error, and a dead link still fails it.

Four of the seven failures were codefactor.io 503s, not github.com,
and lychee never retries a 5xx. Record the root cause, the second-pass
fix (c04967e), lycheeverse/lychee#2193 and the template corrections.

title: fix(ci): clear every false positive, false negative, warning and error in CI/CD
